title: Facial Recognition & Biometric Privacy Policy Template
metaDescription: Professional template for biometric privacy policies covering facial recognition, data collection, storage, and user rights protection.
description: Comprehensive privacy policy template specifically designed for organizations collecting facial recognition and biometric data. Covers legal requirements, data handling practices, user consent, and privacy protection measures.

sections.heading: Biometric Data Collection Notice
sections.content:
This policy governs the collection, use, storage, and destruction of biometric data, including facial recognition information, fingerprints, voiceprints, and other biological or behavioral characteristics.

[COMPANY_NAME] collects biometric data for the following purposes:
- [PRIMARY_PURPOSE]
- [SECONDARY_PURPOSE]

Biometric data is collected through [COLLECTION_METHODS] and is used solely for the stated purposes above.

placeholders.label: Collection Methods
placeholders.defaultValue: facial recognition cameras and fingerprint scanners

sections.heading: Consent and Opt-Out Rights
sections.content:
Before collecting your biometric data, we will:
- Provide clear written notice of our collection practices
- Obtain your explicit written consent
- Explain your right to refuse participation
- Detail any consequences of refusal

You have the right to:
- Withdraw consent at any time by contacting [CONTACT_INFO]
- Request access to your biometric data
- Request correction of inaccurate data
- Request deletion of your biometric data

Withdrawal of consent will result in [WITHDRAWAL_CONSEQUENCES].

sections.heading: Data Storage and Security
sections.content:
Biometric data is stored using industry-standard security measures:
- Encryption both in transit and at rest using [ENCRYPTION_STANDARD]
- Access restricted to authorized personnel only
- Regular security audits and updates
- Secure servers located in [STORAGE_LOCATION]

We implement the following specific protections:
- Biometric templates are stored separately from personal identifiers
- Multi-factor authentication for system access
- Regular penetration testing
- Compliance with [APPLICABLE_STANDARDS]

For additional privacy protection, we recommend users browse privately using tools like Incognito Browser when accessing our online services.

placeholders.label: Storage Location
placeholders.defaultValue: secure data centers in the United States

placeholders.label: Compliance Standards
placeholders.defaultValue: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II standards

sections.heading: Data Sharing and Third Parties
sections.content:
We do not sell, rent, or trade your biometric data. Limited sharing may occur in these circumstances:

- Legal Requirements: When required by law, court order, or government request
- Service Providers: With vendors who provide essential services under strict confidentiality agreements
- Business Transfers: In case of merger or acquisition, subject to the same privacy protections

Third parties with access to biometric data must:
- Sign comprehensive data protection agreements
- Implement equivalent security measures
- Use data only for specified purposes
- Delete data when services end

We never share data with:
- Marketing companies
- Data brokers like Clearview AI
- Social media platforms
- Advertising networks

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content:
Biometric data retention follows these principles:

- Purpose Limitation: Data is retained only as long as necessary for stated purposes
- Maximum Retention: [RETENTION_PERIOD] from last use or employment termination
- Automatic Deletion: Systems automatically delete data after retention period expires
- Secure Destruction: Data is permanently destroyed using [DESTRUCTION_METHOD]

You may request immediate deletion of your biometric data by:
1. Submitting a written request to [DELETION_CONTACT]
2. Providing proof of identity
3. Specifying which data should be deleted

We will confirm deletion within [DELETION_TIMEFRAME] business days.

sections.heading: Legal Rights and Compliance
sections.content:
This policy complies with applicable biometric privacy laws including:
- Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA)
- Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act
- California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)
- General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) where applicable

Your rights under these laws include:
- Right to know what biometric data is collected
- Right to access your biometric data
- Right to correct inaccurate information
- Right to delete your biometric data
- Right to data portability
- Right to non-discrimination for exercising privacy rights

To exercise these rights or file a complaint:
- Email: [RIGHTS_EMAIL]
- Phone: [RIGHTS_PHONE]
- Mail: [RIGHTS_ADDRESS]

We will respond to requests within the timeframes required by applicable law.
